ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: There is a “swallowing and吐ing” relationship between a tributary of a certain large river and the main stream. The figure below shows the annual net runoff (the difference between output runoff and input runoff) and annual net sediment transport (the difference between output sediment amount and input sediment amount) at the outlet of this tributary from 1970 to 2000. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is years, with a range of about 1970–2000; the left vertical axis indicates annual net runoff, with the unit of 100 million cubic meters, and the right vertical axis indicates annual net sediment transport, with the unit of 10,000 tons. The legend shows that the dotted curve is annual net runoff, the dashed line is annual net sediment transport, and the horizontal solid lines indicate the multi-year average values of net runoff and net sediment transport. In the figure, the multi-year average value of annual net runoff is roughly near 150 billion cubic meters, and the multi-year average value of annual net sediment transport is roughly near 10 million tons. The curves have positive and negative fluctuations, reflecting that there is water-sediment exchange of output and input between the tributary outlet and the main stream, namely a “swallowing and吐ing” relationship. Then reason: In China, a tributary/lake water system that has a typical “swallowing and吐ing” relationship with the main stream and shows water-sediment exchange at the outlet often corresponds to the exchange relationship between the Poyang Lake water system at Hukou and the Yangtze River main stream. The Poyang Lake water system finally flows into the Yangtze River through Hukou. Therefore, the river into which this tributary flows is the Yangtze River.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是1970—2000年某出口处年净径流量和年净输沙量曲线，净径流量多年平均值约1500亿m³，净输沙量多年平均值约1000万t，体现有输入也有输出的交换关系。再结合题干说支流与干流有“吞吐”关系，将其对应到我国典型的鄱阳湖—长江干流在湖口一带的水沙交换。既然该支流/湖泊水系对应鄱阳湖水系，其最终汇入的干流就是长江。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中横轴为年份，范围约为1970—2000年；左纵轴表示年净径流量，单位为亿立方米，右纵轴表示年净输沙量，单位为万吨。图例显示点状曲线为年净径流量，虚线为年净输沙量，横向实线表示净径流量、净输沙量多年平均值。图中年净径流量多年平均值大致在1500亿立方米附近，年净输沙量多年平均值大致在1000万吨附近，曲线有正负波动，反映支流出口与干流之间存在输出和输入的水沙交换，即“吞吐”关系。再推理：我国与干流之间具有典型“吞吐”关系、并在出口处表现为水沙交换的支流/湖泊水系，常对应鄱阳湖水系在湖口与长江干流之间的交换关系。鄱阳湖水系最终由湖口汇入长江。因此，该支流流入的河流是长江。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read that net runoff is large in volume but the net sediment amount is only on the order of hundreds to about two thousand 万t, and that both variables fluctuate around positive averages rather than showing extremely high sediment loads.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the textual clue that the key relation is not ordinary单向汇入 but tributary-mainstream “吞吐”, so the receiving river should be inferred from a known regional hydrological setting.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use comparative regional geography: large tributary-mainstream backwater/吞吐 exchange is characteristic of middle-lower Yangtze floodplain lake/tributary systems; the Yellow River would have much higher sediment concentration and lacks this lake-type exchange pattern, while Pearl or other systems do not match the well-known textbook “吞吐” case.
